drops{H5198} of water,{H4325} Which distil{H2212} in rain{H4306} from his vapor,{H108} 28 Which the skies{H7834} pour down{H7491} And drop{H5140} upon man{H120} abundantly.{H7227} 29 Yea, can any understand{H995} the spreadings{H4666} of the clouds,{H5645} The thunderings{H8663} of his pavilion?{H5521} 30 Behold, he spreadeth{H6566} his light{H216} around him; And he covereth{H3680} the And giveth it a charge{H6680} that it strike the mark.{H6293} 33 The noise{H7452} thereof telleth{H5046} concerning him, The cattle{H4735} also concerning [the storm]{H5927} that cometh up.
